hero.title: Seasonal Foods
hero.subtitle: Eat with the season, stay healthy all year round.
hero.description: Seasonal foods are fresher, more nutritious and support your body's natural rhythm. Discover what to eat this season and how they benefit your health.

seasons.name: Summer
seasons.title: What to Eat in Summer
seasons.description: Summer foods help keep your body cool, hydrated and energized.

foods.name: Watermelon
foods.subtitle: Hydrating and rich in lycopene. Helps beat the heat.

foods.name: Cucumber
foods.subtitle: High water content, aids digestion and keeps your body cool.

foods.name: Mango
foods.subtitle: Rich in vitamins A & C. Boosts immunity and improves skin health.

foods.name: Buttermilk
foods.subtitle: Keeps you hydrated, improves digestion and prevents dehydration.

foods.name: Coconut Water
foods.subtitle: Natural electrolyte rich drink. Rehydrates instantly.

foods.name: Mint Leaves
foods.subtitle: Helps cool the body, aids digestion and refreshes.

foods.name: Muskmelon
foods.subtitle: Rich in water and fiber. Helps in hydration and weight management.

foods.name: Lemon
foods.subtitle: Rich in vitamin C, aids digestion and detoxifies the body.

seasons.name: Monsoon
seasons.title: What to Eat in Monsoon
seasons.description: Monsoon superfoods boost immunity, protect against infections, and support digestion.

foods.name: Sweet Corn
foods.subtitle: High in lutein and fiber. Great for digestion and energy.

foods.name: Ginger
foods.subtitle: Natural anti-inflammatory spice. Helps fight seasonal colds.

foods.name: Garlic
foods.subtitle: Potent antimicrobial herb. Enhances gut health and infection immunity.

foods.name: Turmeric
foods.subtitle: Curcumin-rich golden spice that calms internal inflammation.

seasons.name: Winter
seasons.title: What to Eat in Winter
seasons.description: Nourishing winter foods generate natural heat, strengthen immunity, and sustain stamina.

foods.name: Amla (Indian Gooseberry)
foods.subtitle: Concentrated vitamin C superberry for immune warmth and skin radiant glow.

foods.name: Spinach
foods.subtitle: Iron and folate rich leafy green that builds hemoglobin and vitality.

foods.name: Pomegranate
foods.subtitle: Antioxidant ruby seeds supporting heart health and blood circulation.

foods.name: Sweet Potato
foods.subtitle: Beta-carotene complex carb offering sustained thermal warmth.
